lab.title: Design Lab
lab.intro: Every colour, letter and button in LibraryOS in one place — light and dark, Hindi and English. New screens are built only from what's here.
lab.s_status: Status colours (always with an icon and a word)
lab.s_baseline: Hindi and English on one line
lab.baselineHint: Both scripts should sit on the thin line underneath.
lab.motionHint: Sheets open with a spring (stiffness 400, damping 30). Everything else fades in 150–200ms. All motion stops when the phone asks for reduced motion.
lab.sheetBody: It rises from the bottom on a phone and slides in from the right on a computer.
lab.emptyBody: When someone's fees are due, they'll show up here.
lab.footer: This page is for checking design only; students never see it.
